introduction: Nevada Legal Services accepts requests for free civil legal help through online intake or local offices. Describe any court deadline when asking for assistance.
description: Nevada Legal Services accepts requests for free civil legal help through online intake or local offices. Describe any court deadline when asking for assistance.

sections.who: The organization screens income or grant eligibility, the issue and available resources. Services can include housing, public-benefit and consumer issues; not every request results in representation.
sections.get: Depending on the case, assistance may include advice, forms or representation. Southern Nevada residents can also explore Legal Aid Center services, but use that organization’s own current intake rules.
sections.docs:

  • A short timeline and the next hearing or response date.
  • Income and household information for screening.
  • Relevant leases, payment records or correspondence.
sections.apply:
1. Start the NLS intake

    Use Nevada Legal Services’ online intake.

  2. Choose a local contact if needed

    Use the office directory for phone or in-person intake. Fridays and other office arrangements vary.

  3. Confirm the accepted service

    Ask whether the case is accepted and what you must do about deadlines while waiting.
sections.after: Keep the intake confirmation and any instructions. Request another referral if the issue is outside the provider’s scope or it cannot accept the case.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using NLS eligibility and online intake, Services offered, Local intake contacts. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Can NLS help with a benefit termination?
Its published core services include SNAP, TANF and other benefit disputes, subject to intake screening.
Can I walk in at any office any weekday?
No. Office schedules differ, and some Friday visits require appointments. Check the directory.
Does submitting intake assign a lawyer?
No. The organization must confirm the assistance it will provide.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
